text:
violet: heads-up 1  saw a duplicated side-effect in the onboarding sample when a 429 happened while the auth token rotated. short repro below.

raj: yikes. can you paste minimal repro steps?

violet: repro: 1) call quickstart endpoint until server returns 429. 2) force background token refresh while backoff sleeps. 3) SDK retries after refresh with no idempotency header -> duplicate resource created.

emma: summary: race between auth refresh and retry window. quickstart intentionally tiny and omitted idempotency to keep the demo friction-free.

sylvia: proposed quickstart fix: keep page minimal but add a collapsed one-line snippet and a checkbox "Does this call create persistent side effects?" that reveals it. snippet:```js
const id = makeIdempotencyKey(userId, payload)
await client.createResource(payload, { headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': id } })
```

raj: SDK behavior idea: be refresh-aware. add `refreshReplayPolicy` option with values `'allow' | 'require-idempotency' | 'error'`. default `'allow'` for DX but document strict mode (`'error'`) for platforms. Also emit telemetry when a replay was attempted after refresh.

emma: parity note: ensure JS/Py/Go SDKs share defaults (base=100ms, cap=2000ms, factor=2, full-jitter). doc that interactive flows should use smaller caps.

sylvia: telemetry keys to emit: `refresh_replay_attempted:true/false`, `idempotency_present:true/false`, `refresh_handshake_mismatch:true/false`. ops can we add a small server hint header like `X-Idempotency-Required: true` for endpoints where idempotency is enforced?

ops: yes we can add `X-Idempotency-Required` and `Retry-After` on 429s. will also spin up a staging harness to simulate token flips.

ci-bot: CI plan: add an e2e that orchestrates 429 + forced token rotation (deterministic sleeps) and asserts: with idempotency -> single side-effect; without + policy='error' -> surfaced error; without + policy='allow' -> replay occurs and telemetry flagged.

raj: API sketch: `client.request(..., { idempotencyKey?: string, refreshReplayPolicy?: 'allow'|'require-idempotency'|'error' })` and an event hook `on('refreshHandshakeMismatch', cb)` for teams that want to surface UI warnings.

emma: quick PR plan: tiny quickstart change + link to production hardening doc; SDK RFC for option and telemetry; CI e2e. keep quickstart collapsed so onboarding stays tiny.

sylvia: I'll draft the quickstart change and open a WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/1388 (WIP).

violet: thanks all. small UX changes + SDK defaults will avoid a painful customer bug. target: next Tue EOD. :thumbsup:
